unified.oracle: Every online and persisted Parquet value checked against cyclic integer/rational oracle, including complete unique per-site ranges.

limitations: RSS is sampled; this is not a native OS hard process cap.
Disk admission coordinates one store; external writers and other stores can consume space after admission.
Restore streams between bounded records; each individual record is materialized and quota checked.
Scheduler protects pending live demand but never preempts a running worker.
Exact TradingView equivalence remains a separate stage.
